thread:
marta: FYI AcmeBeta just hit intermittent 504s when resuming a streaming request after their token refresh. They say stream drops and the SDK retries, causing duplicate billing. Repro steps included below.

samir: can you paste a trace id or the customer request id? need to pull edge logs.

marta: trace: trace-20260317-acme-01. customer steps: start a streaming generate, wait ~45s to force token rotation, then SDK performs mid-stream reauth and the client sees a final 504. They can repro ~6/10.

marta: repro snippet they used (JS SDK):
```js
const s = client.stream.generate({model: 'rwd-small', input: 'long prompt...'});
setTimeout(() => { // rotate token on client and continue
  client.rotateToken(newToken);
}, 45_000);
```

marta: minimal curl-ish sequence they provided:
```bash
# open streaming connection
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <short-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
# after ~45s client refreshes token and opens new auth on the same logical flow
# server responds with 504 and stream terminates
```

ops-jen: pulling edge logs for trace-20260317-acme-01 now. initial quick look: edge proxy returned `504 upstream timed out awaiting response` around the time of the token rotation.

devon: my hunch: when the SDK refreshes mid-stream it opens a new HTTP/2 stream with a new `Authorization` header while the proxy/runtime still has the old stream context. proxy rejects the connect attempt -> 504. can repro locally with a short script that closes/reopens frames during ongoing KV cache usage.

devon: local repro snippet (python):
```python
import requests, time
s = requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': token}, stream=True)
# read a bit
for chunk in s.iter_content(chunk_size=1024):
    print(chunk)
    if time.time() - start > 40:
        break
s.close()
# simulate SDK reauth and new stream
s2 = requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': new_token}, stream=True)
```

samir: thanks. quick mitigation ideas: 1) recommend customers stagger/rotate tokens off-stream (rotate before opening long streams), 2) SDK: pause output and reattach token rather than reopening the stream mid-flight, or add an idempotency header to dedupe server processing, 3) we can increase the edge idle/handshake timeout as a short-term fix.

ops-jen: I've patched a canary in us-west1 to bump edge idle timeout from 20s -> 60s for streaming routes; monitoring dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/streams/usc1/canary. will watch p95 and 504 rate.

marta: will relay workaround to AcmeBeta: upgrade to SDK build with `earlyTokenRotate: true` flag (we'll ship a patch), or switch to non-streaming generation for now. also ask them to set `Idempotency-Key` on requests to avoid duplicate work if retries happen.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-20260317-42 assigned to ops-jen, samir. https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-20260317-42

samir: next steps: ops-jen to track edge metrics for the canary (30m), devon to propose a minimal server-side guard to accept mid-stream auth transitions safely, marta to confirm customer test results and update.

marta: sending customer note now. will update this thread after their verification. thanks all :pray:

ops-jen: initial canary looks promising, 504s down ~80% in first 10m. continuing watch.

marta: great, I'll keep AcmeBeta in the loop and schedule a follow-up tomorrow for the SDK patch rollout. :thumbsup:
